doc: value[i,j] = data[i,j] * scale[i,0]. Per-output-row fp8 e4m3 with a KEPT trailing unit axis on the scale -- v1's own quantizer output (decisions #187). Physically distinct from the rank-1 variant: a reader that assumes [out] mis-strides this and a reader that assumes [out,1] mis-strides that, which is precisely why they are two digests.
